def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    pedestrians = image_patch.find("pedestrian")
    plaza = image_patch.find("plaza")
    
    if not pedestrians or not plaza:
        return []
    
    plaza_center = (plaza[0].horizontal_center, plaza[0].vertical_center)
    pedestrian_distances = [(p, abs(p.horizontal_center - plaza_center[0])) for p in pedestrians]
    pedestrian_distances.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    
    left_pedestrians = [p for p, d in pedestrian_distances if p.horizontal_center < plaza_center[0]]
    
    return left_pedestrians
